newsitem.title: USA: Shaman prices 2 mln shrs at $4.50/shr.
newsitem.headline: Shaman prices 2 mln shrs at $4.50/shr.

text.p: Shaman Pharmaceuticals Inc said Thursday it has closed a public offering of 2 million shares of common stock at $4.50 a share.
All of the shares were offered by the company. The offering was managed by Hambrecht & Quist.
Shamn said in a statement most of the net proceeds will be used for the continued research and clinical development of the company's existing product candidates.
Shaman Pharmaceuticals discovers and develops novel pharmaceutical products for major human diseases by isolating active compounds from tropical plants.
